# ggscribe

The objective of ggscribe is to provide annotation helper functions for
publication-quality ‘ggplot2’ visualisation.

Note:

- Use the secondary axis, subtitle, or axis titles to adjust space.
- `axis_*` functions placed outside the panel require `clip = "off"` in
  the coord space.

## Installation

Install from CRAN, or the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/davidhodge931/ggscribe).

``` r

install.packages("ggscribe")
pak::pak("davidhodge931/ggscribe")
```

## Other packages

This package is part of a group of related packages built to extend
[ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org).

# Package index

## Secondary axis

- [`sec_axis_text()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/sec_axis_text.md)
  : Secondary axis for text annotations
- [`guide_sec_axis_text()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/guide_sec_axis_text.md)
  : Guide optimised for secondary axis text annotations

## Annotation

- [`annotate_axis_line()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_axis_line.md)
  : Annotate an axis line
- [`annotate_axis_ticks()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_axis_ticks.md)
  : Annotate axis ticks
- [`annotate_axis_bracket()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_axis_bracket.md)
  : Annotate an axis bracket
- [`annotate_axis_text()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_axis_text.md)
  : Annotate axis text
- [`annotate_panel_background()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_panel_background.md)
  : Annotate a panel background region
- [`annotate_panel_grid()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_panel_grid.md)
  : Annotate panel gridlines
- [`annotate_panel_shade()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_panel_shade.md)
  : Annotate a shaded panel region
- [`annotate_reference_line()`](https://davidhodge931.github.io/ggscribe/reference/annotate_reference_line.md)
  : Annotate a reference line
